SENSORIUM. [2] [Arg. m.]
A crawling and whirling in head, as if drunken.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Arg. m.]
Violent itching of lids and corners of eyes. θ Blepharitis.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arg. m.]
Most exhausting fluent coryza, with sneezing. θ Exostosis on skull.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Arg. m.]
Throat feels raw and sore during expiration, or when swallowing or coughing.
Viscid, grey, jelly-like mucus in pharynx, easily hawked up ; early morning.
Tension in fauces on right side, felt only when gaping. θ Aphonia.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Arg. m.]
Great hunger. θ Exostosis on skull.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Arg. m.]
Prolapsus, with pain in left ovary.
Pain in left ovary and back, extending to front and downward. θ Prolapsus.
Pains in left ovary and loins.
Prolapsus uteri ; pain in left ovary ; pain in small of back, extending to front and downward.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arg. m.]
Hoarseness ; especially of professional singers, speakers, etc.
Total loss of voice with professional singers.
Rawness and soreness in upper part of larynx, when coughing, not when swallowing.
Over bifurcation of trachea, a raw spot ; < when using voice, talking or singing.
Eating apples, small piece seemed to stick in larynx, leaving a spot which feels cool, irritates to cough, which does not lessen the sensation.
Deep sighing inhalations relieve the palpitation.
Laughing causes cough ; mucus in larynx. θ Laryngitis.
   

COUGH. [27] [Arg. m.]
Attacks of cough from laughing.
Cough with easy expectoration, white, thickish, looking like boiled starch.
The cough is accompanied with an easy expectoration of white, thick, starch-like mucus, without taste or smell.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Arg. m.]
Great weakness of chest, < left side, as a concomitant to other symptoms.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Arg. m.]
Chest feels sore to touch.
Boil near last rib.
Sweat on chest. θ Exostosis on skull.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Arg. m.]
Numbness in limbs, as if asleep.
Loss of power ; after walking unusual fatigue ; heaviness.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Arg. m.]
Sitting : pains in back and limbs increase ; pains in knees.
Motion : paralytic weakness ; much inclined to move, feels as if she had more power ; pains in menorrhagia ; bruised pain in back, loins and neck <.
   

FEVER. [40] [Arg. m.]
Hectic, 11 A. M. to 12, or 1 P. M. θ In laryngeal and bronchial troubles.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Arg. m.]
Left : cutting into brain from ear ; temple ; headache ; amaurosis ; nostril throbs ; cheek throbs ; molar aches ; cutting under ribs ; arm as if beaten ; over pelvis, bruised ; ovary, cartilages, false ribs ; shocks in arm ; paralytic drawing in upper arm, wrist ; patella.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Arg. m.]
Acts on all cartilages.
Tenderness, tearing pressure and pain in bones.
Copious discharge of mucus ; of pus ; of urine.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Arg. m.]
Worse when touched : pain in muscles of upper arm ; bones of thumb and last phalanges of both big toes.
When pressed upon, parts feel sore as if bruised.
